newsitem.title: CANADA: Vancouver Oct freight traffic rises sharply.
newsitem.headline: Vancouver Oct freight traffic rises sharply.

text.p: Vancouver International Airport said October freight traffic rose 29.9 percent to 9,027 tonnes from October 1995, based on a 39.1 percent increase in inbound freight and a 22.5 percent rise in outbound cargo.
For the first ten months of 1996, freight movements were up 13.8 percent and the broader cargo figure - including mail - was up 12.5 percent.

The airport authority reported that import freight was up 21 percent to 75,101 tonnes in the January-October period while exports were up 8.3 percent to 88,680 tonnes in the same period. -Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
